notes: Copy and paste on every sheet: select with a rectangle or a free loop, copy, and tap anywhere - in this or any other sheet or note - to paste. The last copy is always ready, and five slots keep what you save in them, ideal for a table you need again and again. Copy, Duplicate and Delete now take tables, graphs and figures along. Arithmetic Bootcamp progress and Euler cards now merge between your devices instead of being overwritten.
